rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Working Committee resolution dated 10 August 2019 records that, having considered the views of PCC Presidents, CLP Leaders, AICC Secretaries and Members of Parliament, 'The CWC unanimously resolved that Shri Rahul Gandhi should continue as Congress President' and requested him to accept this decision.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same resolution states: 'However, Shri Rahul Gandhi declined to withdraw his resignation.'

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same resolution continues: 'Consequently, the CWC unanimously resolved to request Smt. Sonia Gandhi to take over as Interim President pending the election of a regular President by the AICC.'
